name: dotclaude
description: Lists the dotclaude plugin and its optional browser plugin.

plugins.name: dotclaude
plugins.description: Adds guards against destructive commands and weakened tests, a check gate before Claude stops, carry-over across compaction, a model lock, working rules, and task agents.

plugins.name: dotclaude-browser
plugins.description: Drives a browser with agent-browser, or with CloakBrowser on sites with bot detection, and reads text CAPTCHAs with offline ddddocr-rs OCR.
